why: The explain flow has no refusal path: when the model answers without calling report_scope, its raw text is rendered as the explanation (ok, no error flag) instead of an error flag. Survives the golden's never-throw resolver wrapper (71926c50f), which made the earlier throwing variant indistinguishable; b_invoke_contract therefore no longer drops (the §13.5 row should drop it).
